data.long_meaning: Emadun is a name derived from the Arabic word ‘amadah’ which means foundation. This name is often given to a child to signify that they will provide a strong and trustworthy foundation for their family and community. The name Emadun carries the meaning “Trustworthy foundation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emadun usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy foundation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
